verdict.rationale: Folk ships an official MCP server, and its help center documents natural-language use cases through Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini: finding relationships in plain language, logging calls by voice, bulk-updating records and importing contacts. That counts as the product's own capability for operating it by natural language. However, the evidence is only help-article titles, and the natural-language path depends on an external AI client. The pricing page lists "AI Assistants" with no detail on any native in-app command interface. Missing for 10: a documented native in-app natural-language command interface, depth on which operations are supported and their limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
